hook.name: LockitcoinRobinhoodFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pools charging 1–5% fees on every swap in native ETH. Buy fees are deducted from the ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees are taken from the ETH output in afterSwap. The fee scales between a per-pool base and max based on the previous swap's tick movement, and is sent immediately to a per-pool fee recipient.
